summary.topic: Assembly of a stylized temple diorama
summary.learning_goal: Communicate a workflow for assembling generated 3D assets; no temple-history lesson is shown.
summary.primary_visualization: Isometric temple, garden and base shown assembled and separated.
summary.primary_interaction: Recorded orbit and exploded assembly; user control is not established.

strengths: Separated pieces make the composition of the scene clear.
weaknesses: No architectural or historical correctness can be verified from a stylized generic temple.
Captioned asset-workflow demonstration teaches little about temples themselves.

strengths: Consistent isometric framing and differentiated roofs, garden and base.
weaknesses: Separation reveals asset groups, not clearly labeled architectural functions.

strengths: The recording contains an assembly state change.
weaknesses: No interactive controls or learner-triggered response is shown.

strengths: Plain background and centered object keep the model visually dominant.
weaknesses: This is a rendered demonstration with captions; complete website navigation and mobile design are absent.

principles_to_learn: Separate authored asset groups along interpretable directions.
Keep object scale and stage stable while showing assembly.
Explain which parts belong to which production step.
things_not_to_copy: Do not award temple-history teaching credit for an asset demonstration.
Do not claim a prerecorded explosion is direct manipulation.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for assembly demonstration. Live behavior remains unverified.
